errors.evidence: The figure is a nested donut chart with two hierarchical levels (inner and outer rings), not a simple pie chart.

errors.text_span: The chart is divided into ten slices
errors.evidence: The chart has a complex structure with an inner ring of 4 slices and an outer ring of 16 slices. The description incorrectly simplifies this to 'ten slices' and only lists 10 of the 16 outer categories.

The description omits the four main categories of the inner ring (Perception Layer, Semantic Layer, Cultural Layer, Signal Layer) and several categories from the outer ring (e.g., Asthetic Analysis, Imagination, Anomaly Detection, Audio Difference Analysis).
The chart label is 'Emotion & Intention', not 'Emotion & Perception'.
The colors used are shades of blue and greyish-blue, not purple.

The value 4.3% is explicitly labeled for the 'Signal Layer', which is the parent category for 'Acoustic Quality Analysis'. The 'Acoustic Quality Analysis' slice itself does not have a percentage label.
The description omits the percentage value for the 'Perception Layer', which is 40.4%.

errors.text_span: A legend is present to the upper left of the chart, labeling each category with its corresponding color.
errors.evidence: The chart does not have a legend. All categories are labeled directly on the slices.

errors.text_span: The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from larger to smaller proportions
errors.evidence: This statement is inaccurate. While the four inner slices are ordered by size, the sixteen outer slices do not follow a consistent size-based ordering.
